caseName: Insurance Co. of Pennsylvania v. Ben Cooper, Inc.
caseNameFull: INSURANCE COMPANY OF the STATE OF PENNSYLVANIA v. BEN COOPER, INC.

opinions.text:
The motion of United Missouri Bank of Kansas City, N.A. for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae is granted. The motion of United States for leave to intervene is granted.

Justice SOUTER took no part in the consideration or decision of these motions.
